subtitle: Lesson 38 · Performance Troubleshooting with T-SQL

eyebrow: The server feels slow — start here
code:
SELECT TOP 20 qs.execution_count,
    qs.total_worker_time / 1000 AS total_cpu_ms,
    qs.total_elapsed_time / 1000 AS total_duration_ms,
    st.text AS query_text
FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats AS qs
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(qs.sql_handle) AS st
ORDER BY qs.total_worker_time DESC;
caption: total_worker_time is cumulative CPU across every execution.

steps.label: Average
steps.sub: worst single execution — one report's complaint

code:
SELECT TOP 20 qs.execution_count,
    qs.total_logical_reads,
    qs.total_logical_reads / qs.execution_count
        AS avg_logical_reads,
    st.text AS query_text
FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats AS qs
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(qs.sql_handle) AS st
ORDER BY qs.total_logical_reads DESC;
caption: A query near the top of both lists is worth tuning first.
